# SourceryKit

> Python SDK for Provably: makes AI agent answers verifiable. Records the HTTP calls an
> agent's tools make, then checks every statement of the agent's plain-text answer against
> what those calls returned, with a proof for every value that anyone can verify. A
> statement the data contradicts is CAUGHT, not shipped. Async; supports httpx, aiohttp,
> requests.

## Start

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — agent entry point: the flow, rules, and links

## Cookbooks (runnable)

- [OpenAI Agents SDK](cookbooks/openai_agents/) — one agent; the report explained
- [Claude Agent SDK](cookbooks/claude_agent/) — in-process MCP tool
- [LangChain](cookbooks/langchain_agent/) — `create_agent`
- [Claude Agent SDK, multi-tool](cookbooks/claude_agent_multi_tool/) — one tool called twice
- [OpenAI Agents SDK, multi-agent](cookbooks/openai_agents_multi_agent/) — orchestrator and specialists
- [LangGraph](cookbooks/langgraph_multi_agent/) — verify, then heal
- [CrewAI](cookbooks/crewai_multi_agent/) — a crew, verify, then remediate

## Install

`pip install sourcerykit` (Python 3.12+, PyPI: sourcerykit)
